SAIR (@SAIRfoundation)

Terence Tao: AI is creating a “traffic jam” in math

If AI generates more proofs than humans can verify, science needs new infrastructure. SAIR competitions build that infrastructure by surfacing high-quality results, so the best work is not lost in a flood of AI-generated math.

The main thing that come through reading the SpaceX S-1 is how much Musk and Altman have in common.

when you think about it SpaceX has cumulatively lost a lot less than OpenAI so maybe it’s a bargain?

or maybe we just shouldn’t value companies at a trillion dollars until they actually show evidence of consistent profitability?  

silly me.

what happens when you build it fast, but you don’t really know how to fix it.
